column1: # The routes of the proofs in Gusfield et al. 2007 and in the sources it cites: which numbered results each proof uses.
# Columns: label, environment, the paper proves it (1/0), results used.
# Every label is assigned here or taken from the paper's TeX, and appears in the docstrings of the Lean results. Each paper has a section below.
# No author TeX exists: written by hand from the PMC author manuscript, PMC2581772 (the line numbers in the Lean docstrings are those of its plain text).
# Labels of the form g:thm1, g:lem1 are for numbered results; the others are claims made in running text that a proof uses, assigned here.
# A cited source is a row with paper-proves 0 and the prefix ext:.
# Section 4.1: recurrent and back mutation as recombination (lines 358, 511), with what the Lean proofs of Section 5.2 need from them.
# Section 5.2, in the order of the proofs. Theorem 5 and Corollary 2 "follow immediately" from Theorem 9 (line 554).
# Line 608: the example of Section 5.3.1 refutes the rooted conjecture too. Line 590: the failure of the unrooted conjectures "also implies that the rooted versions are false", by line 403.
# Line 590: Conjecture 1 of Huson and Klöpper, read from Conjecture 2.2 of Klöpper's thesis.
# Tools of the Lean proofs, which the paper doesn't state: where a label can come from, trimming to the rows, and a network from the parents of its nodes.
# Written by hand from the sources that were read, each README saying which. Rows with paper-proves 1 are those whose printed proof the Lean proof is compared with.
